items.reason: A 2.5% benzoyl peroxide wash is a gentler place to start for jawline breakouts, and it can leave skin feeling less dry or irritated than the 5% wash.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable and balanced while a benzoyl peroxide wash is new to your routine.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides gives daily sun protection and suits deeper skin tones, helping marks look less noticeable.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day at first, rinse well, then follow with moisturizer, and wear sunscreen every morning; if your skin feels comfortable after a few weeks you can consider the 5% wash. Benzoyl peroxide can bleach towels and pillowcases, so rinse thoroughly and use white linens.
